about_the_game:
Shoot, build, upgrade and defend, in this gruesome shooter meets tower defense. Carefully balance between economy and upgrading your weapon or towers. How many waves can you survive?

Story

The world is shattered by an apocalyptic asteroid impact, releasing a virus mutating humans into oil-craving, biomechanical horrors. As the lone survivor aboard your oil rig, you must protect your central oil intake, your last remaining lifeline, from endless waves of mutants.

Gameplay

Prepare during the day, fight during the night.

Upgrade your core to increase your income, but don't be greedy, or you might find yourself lacking defenses. Build and upgrade towers, or buff your weapon instead. The better your aim, the fewer defenses you'll need!

Online Leaderboard

How long can you last? Compete will other players online to reach the best highscore. The more waves you survive, and the more enemies you kill, the higher you'll rise!

content_descriptors.notes: In this game, you have to shoot mutants to defend your oil rig. Doing so will cause blood splatters, especially if you hit them in the head.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 1060
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

Recommended:

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060
